content: The EthTSyn module shall use for latency calculation  either static Pdelay values ( EthTSynGlobalTimePropagationDelay ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00070 : ) )  or runtime - based values calculated by Pdelay_Req , Pdelay_Resp , Pdelay_Resp_Follow_Up according to Figure 3 , depending on configuration of EthTSynGlobalTimeTxPdelayReqPeriod ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00071 : ) .
